scope.meaning: This manifest records the nondefault native-mimalloc-shadow source path and its bounded evidence. Source/module inspection can show selected temporary scaffolding, but final hot-path values require independently generated production-general runtime and artifact evidence.

local_hot_path_process_scheduler_ops.unit: process-global scheduler operations per steady-state local allocator operation
local_hot_path_process_scheduler_ops.source_limit: A selected source indicator proves the current route retains scheduler machinery, not an exact dynamic operation count.

local_hot_path_global_pagemap_leases.unit: global PageMap mutation leases per steady-state local allocator operation
local_hot_path_global_pagemap_leases.source_limit: A selected source indicator proves the current route retains the lease machinery, not an exact dynamic operation count.

local_operation_owner_registry_scans.unit: owner-registry scans per local allocator operation
local_operation_owner_registry_scans.source_limit: Source matching records the registry traversal implementation; runtime tracing is required to attribute it to every local operation.

local_operation_client_ledger_scans.unit: client-ledger scans per local allocator operation
local_operation_client_ledger_scans.source_limit: Source matching records the selected ledger and traversal implementation; runtime tracing is required for operation counts.

remote_free_owner_registry_scans.source_limit: Source matching records the exact-client owner traversal; runtime tracing is required for a dynamic complexity claim.

extra_control_bytes_per_live_allocation.unit: extra non-page-local control bytes per live allocation
extra_control_bytes_per_live_allocation.source_limit: Selected ledger types establish that extra control metadata remains, but only a layout/runtime probe can measure bytes per live allocation.

per_call_engine_park_resume.source_limit: Selected suspend/resume definitions and calls are an architecture warning, not a proof that each public call exercises them.

exited_owner_admission_survives_thread_e.unit: exited-owner admission survives until a later worker completion
exited_owner_admission_survives_thread_e.source_limit: The admission-carrying route fields show the temporary representation remains selected; a lifecycle probe is required to prove final behavior.

single_thread_throughput_ratio.source_limit: This is a qualified runtime measurement; selected source cannot establish a throughput ratio.
